set.name: Fishing
set.theme: A lazy summer day of lake fishing: gear, bait and the one that got away.
set.producer_notes: New set not present in the current 16. Warm nostalgic mood, lots of turquoise and orange, no dead fish, keep it cute. Two gold cards.

cards.name: Bobber
cards.object: A classic round fishing float, red top half and white bottom half with a small yellow stem, glossy plastic, floating diagonally with a short piece of line.

cards.name: Tackle Box
cards.object: An open orange plastic tackle box with two fold-out trays holding big colorful lures and bobbers, chunky latch and handle.

cards.name: Rod
cards.object: A fishing rod with a cork handle and a big round reel, leaning upright at a slight angle, a bobber hanging from the line.

cards.name: Bucket
cards.object: A dented metal bucket full of water with two cheerful cartoon fish peeking out, a rope handle.

cards.name: Lure
cards.object: A big shiny fishing lure shaped like a little green-and-yellow fish with a cartoon eye and a silver spinner blade, hanging on a hook.

cards.name: Camp Stool
cards.object: A folding camp stool with a striped turquoise-and-white canvas seat and light wooden legs, a rolled-up fishing magazine on it.

cards.name: Net
cards.object: A landing net with a wooden handle and a turquoise mesh, a single round cartoon fish caught inside looking surprised.

cards.name: Boat
cards.object: A small red-and-white wooden rowboat with two oars, tied to a wooden post, gently floating.
cards.environment_details: soft reeds, a wooden pier post, distant treeline, orange sunset reflection on the water

cards.name: Big Catch
cards.scene: The man proudly holds up a fishing rod bending under a huge catch, but on the hook is only an old rubber boot; the pig behind him applauds with genuine delight.
cards.object: A fishing rod bent in an arc, an old brown rubber boot dripping water on the hook, a tackle box at their feet.
cards.environment: wooden fishing pier on a lake
cards.environment_details: turquoise water, wooden planks, reeds, a bright morning sky

cards.name: Nap Time
cards.scene: The rooster has fallen asleep in a camp chair with the fishing rod between its feet, while a fish leaps out of the water right in front of it and steals the bait with a grin.
cards.object: A striped camp chair, a fishing rod, a straw hat slipping over the rooster's eyes, a leaping cartoon fish with the bobber in its mouth.
cards.environment_details: orange sky, calm water with sun reflection, a few reeds
